content.value: A coil spring is to be used for the front spring of an automobile. The spring is to have a rate of 4 ${ \mathfrak { l b } } / { \mathrm { i n . } } ,$ an inside diameter of $4 ^ { 3 } / \textcircled { 6 4 }$ in., and a free length of 14/ in., with squared and ground ends. The material is to be oil tempered chrome-vanadium steel. Decide upon the diameter of wire and the number of free coils for a design load on $\mathrm { F } = 2 5 0 0$ lb. Be sure ‘solid stress’ is all right. How much is the pitch angle?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
